title: Seed curves — per tag × drop fraction × outcome across seeds 0, 1, 2
note: coin / charter / malformed on the primary slice `eval_trained_conflict__heldout`, shared on the agreement slice `eval_trained_agreement__heldout`. rate_seed<id> / n_seed<id> = that seed's cell (NaN = cell absent in that seed; n_seeds counts the finite ones). sd = SD across seeds (ddof = 1), se = sd / √n_seeds, [t_lo, t_hi] = mean ± t(df = n_seeds − 1) · se clipped to [0, 1] — with three seeds t = 4.30, descriptive only. pooled_* = Wilson 95 % CI of Σk / Σn over the seeds (treats seeds as exchangeable draws of one binomial). wilson_halfwidth_mean / binomial_se_mean = the single-cell eval-noise scale. borrowed = the cell is the sibling ΔL tag's in ≥ 1 seed (n_seeds_borrowed says how many; a random tag's drop000 always, its drop100 when it has no own parent eval). seed_invariant = the 100 % row (the same parent, no EFT — nothing re-seeded reaches it).
